title: Connecting Bluetooth Devices
drDigitalIntro:
Bluetooth lets your computer talk to nearby devices without any wires — like wireless headphones, keyboards, and mice.
• When you want to connect a device, open Settings, go to Bluetooth, and click Connect next to it. The device must be powered on and in range (about 10 metres).
• Once connected, the device shows 'Connected' in the list. Your computer will remember it and reconnect automatically next time.
• To disconnect a device — for example to share your headphones with a phone — click Disconnect. The device stays in the list so you can reconnect easily.
• If a device will not connect, try turning Bluetooth off and back on, or restart the device you are connecting.
• One device at a time is usually the rule: if your headphones are connected to your computer, they may not play sound from your phone at the same time.

playgroundTask.goal: Connect your wireless headphones and then disconnect them

steps.say: Open the Bluetooth section in Settings.
Click Connect next to Wireless Headphones.
Now click Disconnect to unpair the headphones.

drDigitalSuccess: You connected and disconnected a Bluetooth device! Now you know how to pair wireless accessories with your computer.
drDigitalHint: Open Settings on the left, click Bluetooth, then use the Connect and Disconnect buttons next to Wireless Headphones.
